where.if: AND (p.part_sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.part_sn, p.part_type, p.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, p.batch_no, p.qc_status, p.bind_status, p.current_vehicle_id, (SELECT v.vehicle_qr_code FROM bike_vehicle v WHERE v.id=p.current_vehicle_id) AS current_vehicle_qr_code, p.current_frame_sn, p.status, p.inbound_time, p.remark, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM bike_part p LEFT JOIN bike_supplier s ON s.id = p.supplier_id ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_supplier WHERE id=#{supplierId} AND status='ENABLED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_part(part_sn, part_type, supplier_id, batch_no, qc_status, bind_status, status, inbound_time, remark) VALUES(#{partSn}, #{partType}, #{supplierId}, #{batchNo}, #{qcStatus}, 'UNBOUND', 'AVAILABLE', NOW(3), #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_part SET supplier_id = #{request.supplierId}, batch_no = #{request.batchNo}, qc_status = #{request.qcStatus}, status = COALESCE(#{request.status}, status), remark = #{request.remark} WHERE id = #{id}
